Bug_Explanation: The method bar uses string.trim().length() > 0 to check if the string is not blank. This approach is inefficient because it creates a new String object after trimming to check its length. The same inefficient check is used in the showBug method.
Trigger_Explanation: The test cases trigger the bug by using strings that are either only whitespace or contain non-whitespace characters. The bug is due to the inefficient check using string.trim().length(), which is expected to fail for only whitespace strings, causing the test case to fail when checking for non-emptiness.
